measurement_model: Closed two-compartment linear exchange: dx/dt=K*x for COLUMN state x, with the supplied known K. The baseline sensor reports x_1(t)+b. Both initial amounts and one constant additive instrument offset b are unknown. All source readings are exact for this identification study; no noise model or regularization is authorized. Nonnegative initial amounts are allowed but not assumed to resolve missing information.
selection_policy: Add exactly ONE follow-up to all baseline readings. Eligible means it uniquely identifies BOTH initial amounts AND b from the full measurement model. Choose the lowest-cost eligible follow-up; lexical ID breaks a cost tie. Source order of followups is not a priority. Report eligible IDs without duplicates.
identification_policy: Baseline identifiability asks whether a quantity is constant over every nonnegative initial state and real b compatible with all baseline observations. A finite minimum-norm estimate is not a proof of identification. For the selected follow-up return initial amounts in state_order and b.

provenance.data_origin: Project-constructed numerical studies with explicit physical/statistical working assumptions; not experimental performance claims.
